description: Pre-launch on/off, fail-closed negative guard and non-404 routing
Consent defaults deny and supports accept, reject and revoke
Anonymous and authenticated /app paths exist and never return 404
Competitive catalog, Paddle sandbox checkout, signed webhook, entitlement and portal
Normal users receive 403; allowlisted admin action is audited
Support mailto and contact page are available
Critical launch surfaces have no serious or critical automated WCAG violations
Fixtures, browser diagnostics and artifacts contain no real credentials or PII
No analytics request occurs before explicit analytics consent
Accept-Language and URL/profile/cookie precedence, English fallback and language changes
en/it/es/fr/de matrix covers public, app, admin, consent, pricing, pre-launch and email rendering
Transactional events use the F14 Mailronix boundary and render every locale
Every critical security and launch guard has an explicit failing-path assertion
